card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, the, first) and word parts inside descriptions of archaeological or museum finds, such as tombs, stones, jaws, paintings and inscriptions.

card.writes: It pushes toward rating words and away from conservation and restoration words, so it mainly keeps those continuations from appearing.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in articles about archaeological digs and finds, where a description of the object comes next.
